topics.description: The leadership change at Minnesota DHS has been making headlines due to the sudden removal of Commissioner Shireen Gandhi. This change comes amid fraud scrutiny and a day before a confirmation hearing.
The investigation into 9 daycare centers raided by federal agents has revealed that Minnesota sent $67 million to these centers. This has raised concerns about potential fraud and misuse of funds.
topics.reason: Large sum of money sent to raided daycare centers
